# Vogelfrei

> An OSR tabletop role-playing game of exile, survival, and fortune.

This is the complete rulebook. Pages are listed in reading order.

The book ships two views of itself, named after B/X — `base` and
`expert` — and a bracketed note marks any page that is not in both.
Nothing is hidden from the reader by tier: the gating only prunes the
site navigation.

## Book

- [Vogelfrei](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/index.md): Vogelfrei is structured into several chapters:
- [Table of Contents](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/toc/index.md)

## Character Creation

- [Character Creation](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/index.md): Character creation follows these steps in order:
- [Ability Scores](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Ability%20Scores/index.md): Roll 3d6 for each ability score (Strength, Intelligence, Willpower, Agility, Toughness, Leadership) in order, and record them on your character sheet.
- [Choose a class and career](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Class%20and%20Career/index.md): All people encountered in the game world will have a class, most with no career advances, and those are known as zero level characters.

## Character Creation › Classes

- [Classes](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/index.md): Each character belongs to one Class, which defines their core abilities and available Careers.

## Character Creation › Classes › Warrior

- [Warrior](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/index.md): Warriors are the most career-diverse class.

## Character Creation › Classes › Warrior › Careers

- [Duellist](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Duellist/index.md): Duellist may wield a weapon in either hand, one of which must be small or minor sized, and rolls both weapon damage dice when he attacks, using whichever result is higher.
- [Knight](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Knight/index.md): At start, a Knight gains a 0-level squire as a henchman.
- [Mercenary](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Mercenary/index.md): Mercenary can draw a single stowed or holstered weapon, or switch weapons and attack in the same round without penalty.
- [Pit Fighter](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Pit%20Fighter/index.md): Pit Fighter is good at wrestling and unarmed attacks.
- [Soldier](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Soldier/index.md): Soldiers reduce their Encumbrance by 1 and suffer only half damage from forced marches.
- [Witch Hunter](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Warrior/Careers/Witch%20Hunter/index.md): Witch Hunters add half their level (rounded up) to all magic-related saving throws.

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User

- [Magic-User](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/index.md): Magic-Users belong to the arcane traditions:

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › Careers

- [Witch](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Careers/Witch/index.md): This career is not written yet, so it is not yet supported in play.
- [Wizard](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Careers/Wizard/index.md): The numbered columns show how many spells of each spell level the Wizard may keep memorized at one time.

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › Special Rules

- [Spell Scrolls](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Special%20Rules/Magical%20Activities/index.md): Scrolls are magical items which allow a Magic-User to cast a spell without prior memorization, even if the spell is of a higher level than the Magic-User is able to cast. [expert only]
- [Spells](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Special%20Rules/Spells/index.md): Magic-Users' minds are often above using a simple book to store their knowledge, so, depending on their learning origin, they might use clay tablets, inscribed weapons or their own body parts to write down spells.

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells

- [List of Magic-User Spells](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/index.md)

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 1

- [Bookspeak](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Bookspeak/index.md): When the subject of this spell touches a book, it animates, forming a mouth around the edge where the paper shows.
- [Charm Person](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Charm%20Person/index.md): The Charm Person spell makes a single subject utterly enamoured with the caster and desperate to please them if the saving throw versus Magic is failed.
- [Comprehend Languages](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Comprehend%20Languages/index.md): The caster can understand the spoken words of creatures or read otherwise incomprehensible written messages by summoning the spirits of the all-knowing dead to translate for them.
- [Detect Magic](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Detect%20Magic/index.md): This spell allows the caster to know if anything within their field of vision (or on their person) is in any way magical.
- [Enlarge](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Enlarge/index.md): This spell causes instant growth (and corresponding increase in weight and damage done) of a single object or creature that is in visible range.
- [Faerie Fire](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Faerie%20Fire/index.md): A pale glow surrounds and outlines the subjects, making them hypervisible.
- [Feather Fall](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Feather%20Fall/index.md): The affected creatures or objects in range fall slowly.
- [Floating Disc](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Floating%20Disc/index.md): The caster creates a slightly concave, circular plane of force that follows them about and carries a heavy load for them.
- [Hold Portal](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Hold%20Portal/index.md): This spell magically holds shut a door, gate, window, or shutter of wood, metal, or stone.
- [Identify](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Identify/index.md): This spell allows the Magic-User to discern the magical properties of an item.
- [Light](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Light/index.md): This spell creates a light source equivalent to that of a torch in the target area of the spell.
- [Magic Aura](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Magic%20Aura/index.md): This spell makes an object appealing to the microcosmic forces of magic, giving the item an aura that causes it to register to Detect spells (and spells with similar capabilities) as though it were magical.
- [Magic Missile](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Magic%20Missile/index.md): A missile of magical energy shoots forth from the caster’s fingertip and strikes its target, dealing damage equal to 1d3 per level of the caster (so a second-level Magic-User deals 2d3 points of damage).
- [Mending](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Mending/index.md): Mending repairs small breaks or tears in objects.
- [Message](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Message/index.md): This spell grants the caster the ability to whisper messages and receive whispered replies.
- [Read Magic](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Read%20Magic/index.md): By means of Read Magic, the caster can decipher magical inscriptions on objects—books, scrolls, weapons, and the like—that would otherwise be unintelligible.
- [Shield](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Shield/index.md): Magic-Users are masters of matter and as such can command objects racing towards them to stop.
- [Sleep](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Sleep/index.md): A Sleep spell causes a magical slumber to come upon creatures with 4+1 or fewer Hit Dice.
- [Spider Climb](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Spider%20Climb/index.md): The subject can climb and travel on vertical surfaces or even traverse ceilings as a spider does.
- [Summon](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Summon/index.md): Magic fundamentally works by ripping a hole in the fabric of space and time and pulling out energy that interacts with and warps our reality.
- [Unseen Servant](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%201/Unseen%20Servant/index.md): An Unseen Servant is an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at the caster’s command.

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 2

- [Audible Glamour](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Audible%20Glamour/index.md): The caster of this spell is able to create false sound.
- [Change Self](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Change%20Self/index.md): This spell creates a dweomer of illusion, altering the caster’s appearance.
- [Continual Light](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Continual%20Light/index.md): This spell creates a light source equivalent to that of a torch in the target area of the spell.
- [Detect Invisible](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Detect%20Invisible/index.md): By means of this spell the caster is able to see invisible characters, creatures, or objects within the given range, seeing them as translucent shapes.
- [ESP](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/ESP/index.md): If you know how to listen, thoughts are as audible as any voice, and those who care not about the privacy of all living things can hear them.
- [Force of Forbidment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Force%20of%20Forbidment/index.md): The caster can block one subject of less than 6 Hit Dice from being able to advance past a certain point, the subject being blocked by a wall of magical force.
- [Forget](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Forget/index.md): This spell allows the caster to obliterate the memory of an opponent.
- [Invisibility](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Invisibility/index.md): With this spell the Magic-User frightens the light of the world, causing it to avoid the subject of the spell.
- [Knock](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Knock/index.md): This spell allows the Magic-User to speak to a stuck, barred, locked, Held, or Wizard Locked door and convince it to open for him.
- [Levitate](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Levitate/index.md): Levitate allows the caster to move himself, another creature, or an object up and down as desired.
- [Locate Object](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Locate%20Object/index.md): The caster can sense the direction of a well-known or clearly visualized object.
- [Magic Mouth](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Magic%20Mouth/index.md): This enchantment is set upon an object, and the magic is triggered when certain conditions established by the caster are met.
- [Mirror Image](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Mirror%20Image/index.md): This spell grabs 1d4 duplicates of the caster from near-identical timelines to confuse foes and make it more difficult for the original caster to come to harm.
- [Phantasmal Force](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Phantasmal%20Force/index.md): This spell creates a creature the caster has previously seen that will obey his every mental command.
- [Ray of Enfeeblement](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Ray%20of%20Enfeeblement/index.md): When this spell is cast, a coruscating ray shoots from the caster’s hand.
- [Speak with Animals](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Speak%20with%20Animals/index.md): The caster can comprehend and communicate with ordinary animals or giant versions of ordinary animals.
- [Stinking Cloud](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Stinking%20Cloud/index.md): Stinking Cloud creates a 20' cubed bank of fog centred anywhere within range, making living creatures within it helpless with nausea.
- [Wall of Fog](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Wall%20of%20Fog/index.md): The caster of this spell creates an opaque, fog-like vapour in a 20' cube area per caster level.
- [Web](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Web/index.md): This spell causes a large volume of sticky, disgusting strands of goo to shoot forth from the caster’s mouth into an area approximately 20 feet square.
- [Wizard Lock](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%202/Wizard%20Lock/index.md): Some doors are never meant to be opened.

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 3

- [Army of One](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Army%20of%20One/index.md): The recipient of this spell becomes a peerless warrior, able to move in battle with inhuman reflexes in order to attack enemies within immediate melee range. [expert only]
- [Clairvoyance](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Clairvoyance/index.md): Clairvoyance is a means of seeing and hearing events at a distant location. [expert only]
- [Detect Illusion](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Detect%20Illusion/index.md): The caster places this enchantment on himself to grant sight that sees through illusion. [expert only]
- [Dispel Magic](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Dispel%20Magic/index.md): As a Magic-User grows in knowledge and power, he becomes able to dismiss magic as well as conjure it. [expert only]
- [Explosive Runes](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Explosive%20Runes/index.md): Magic-Users are miserly and jealous people, guarding their secrets as if they can take them to the grave. [expert only]
- [False Alignment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/False%20Alignment/index.md): This spell masks the caster’s true alignment. [expert only]
- [Fly](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Fly/index.md): For a number of Turns equal to the caster’s level +1d6 Turns, the caster can fly with a maximum movement of 120' each Round. [expert only]
- [Gaseous Form](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Gaseous%20Form/index.md): The subject, but not his gear, becomes insubstantial, shapeless, misty, and translucent. [expert only]
- [Gust of Wind](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Gust%20of%20Wind/index.md): This spell summons forth a powerful blast of air, forceful enough to blow out unprotected flames. [expert only]
- [Haste](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Haste/index.md): This spell makes creatures move and act more quickly than normal. [expert only]
- [Hold Person](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Hold%20Person/index.md): This spell projects a mystic force (unique to each formulation of the spell; different forms must be researched and prepared separately) that paralyzes living human and human-like targets. [expert only]
- [Howl of the Moon](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Howl%20of%20the%20Moon/index.md): The Magic-User summons the primal self that exists within all humanity. [expert only]
- [Invisibility 10' Radius](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Invisibility%2010%27%20Radius/index.md): The caster’s rage is so great that the light is terrified on a grand scale, and any beings, and their carried equipment, within 10' of the caster at the time of the casting become invisible as per the Invisibility spell. [expert only]
- [Phantasmal Psychedelia](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Phantasmal%20Psychedelia/index.md): This spell creates a creature the caster has previously seen that will obey his every mental command. [expert only]
- [Protection from Normal Missiles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Protection%20from%20Normal%20Missiles/index.md): While under the effects of this spell, the caster or subject is completely unharmed by small and non-magical missiles. [expert only]
- [Secret Page](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Secret%20Page/index.md): This spell allows the caster to disguise a single page in a book (or inscriptions on a tombstone, a framed painting, or any sort of medium analogous to a “page”) as something else. [expert only]
- [Speak with Dead](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Speak%20with%20Dead/index.md): This spell rips the spirit of a corpse from the afterlife and returns it to its body. [expert only]
- [Strange Waters II](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Strange%20Waters%20II/index.md): This spell creates a small sphere of water, filled with twenty small fish, in the air which immediately crashes to the ground. [expert only]
- [Suggestion](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Suggestion/index.md): The Magic-User is an expert in tricking the nether forces into revealing their secrets, and thus magic use was born. [expert only]
- [Water Breathing](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%203/Water%20Breathing/index.md): The subject of this spell grows gills in his neck, his skin takes on a scaly texture, and he gains the ability to breathe water freely for the duration of the spell. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 4

- [Charm Monster](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Charm%20Monster/index.md): The Charm Monster spell makes its subject utterly enamoured with the caster and desperate to please him if the saving throw versus Magic is failed. [expert only]
- [Confusion](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Confusion/index.md): This spell touches the minds of any living creatures within a 15' radius circle around the target point to see the interconnectedness of everything in creation, causing them to become confused, making them unable to… [expert only]
- [Dig](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Dig/index.md): This lesser form of Move Earth allows the caster to dig or excavate areas of soil, mud, or sand in 10' cube increments. [expert only]
- [Dimension Door](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Dimension%20Door/index.md): This is a minor version of the Teleport spell, allowing the caster to instantly transfer the subject from its current location to any other known spot within 360'. [expert only]
- [Extension](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Extension/index.md): This spell reminds magic forces that they are not bound by natural time and so lengthens the duration of another spell previously cast by the Magic-User by 50%. [expert only]
- [Hallucinatory Terrain](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Hallucinatory%20Terrain/index.md): The caster makes some terrain look, sound, and smell like another sort of terrain, but the entire terrain to be hidden must be encompassed by the range that this spell can affect. [expert only]
- [Improved Invisibility](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Improved%20Invisibility/index.md): With this spell the Magic-User frightens the light of the world, causing it to avoid the subject of the spell. [expert only]
- [Minor Creation](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Minor%20Creation/index.md): The caster creates an object of nonliving vegetable matter (rope, cloth, wood, etc.). [expert only]
- [Minor Globe of Invulnerability](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Minor%20Globe%20of%20Invulnerability/index.md): An immobile, faintly shimmering magical 10' diameter sphere surrounds the caster and excludes all Magic-User spell effects of 3rd level or lower. [expert only]
- [Mnemonic Enhancer](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Mnemonic%20Enhancer/index.md): This spell allows the caster to prepare additional spells or retain spells recently cast. [expert only]
- [Plant Growth](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Plant%20Growth/index.md): Plant Growth causes normal vegetation (grasses, bushes, creepers, thistles, trees, vines, etc.) within range and a 20' square area per level to become thick and overgrown. [expert only]
- [Polymorph Others](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Polymorph%20Others/index.md): By means of this spell, one living being can be transformed into another kind of being. [expert only]
- [Polymorph Self](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Polymorph%20Self/index.md): The caster transforms himself into another being. [expert only]
- [Protection from Normal Weapons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Protection%20from%20Normal%20Weapons/index.md): The subject of this spell becomes completely invulnerable to the effects of non-magical weapons. [expert only]
- [Seven Gates](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Seven%20Gates/index.md): Seven pre-prepared gates (some marker must be placed at the gate’s intended location) at a distance of up to five miles from each other are activated, allowing people to move between them. [expert only]
- [Shadow Monsters](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Shadow%20Monsters/index.md): The caster creates phantasmal pseudo-real monsters in an area 20' square. [expert only]
- [Speak with Plants](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Speak%20with%20Plants/index.md): The caster can communicate with plants, including both normal plants and plant creatures. [expert only]
- [Wall of Fire](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Wall%20of%20Fire/index.md): This spell calls up a blazing inferno of flame in the shape of a wall. [expert only]
- [Wall of Ice](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Wall%20of%20Ice/index.md): An immobile, translucent, wall of ice springs into existence for the duration of the spell. [expert only]
- [Wizard Eye](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%204/Wizard%20Eye/index.md): The caster creates an invisible magical sensor that sends visual information, and can see with 60' darkvision. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 5

- [Airy Water](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Airy%20Water/index.md): The caster of this spell creates a bubble of altered water in a body of water (or water-based medium). [expert only]
- [Animate Dead](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Animate%20Dead/index.md): This spell energizes the faint memories of life that cling to the corpses and skeletons of people, allowing them to move and act in a gross mockery of their former existence. [expert only]
- [Chaos](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Chaos/index.md): This spell connects creatures with the greater truths of the universe, so overwhelming them that they behave strangely and unpredictably. [expert only]
- [Cloudkill](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Cloudkill/index.md): Casting this spell allows the smoke emitted from the infernal fires of Hell to spew forth onto the Earth to cause destruction and suffering. [expert only]
- [Contact Outer Sphere](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Contact%20Outer%20Sphere/index.md): The stars are repositories of all knowledge. [expert only]
- [Faithful Hound](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Faithful%20Hound/index.md): This spell summons a guardian spirit to act as a guard dog for a particular area. [expert only]
- [Feeblemind](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Feeblemind/index.md): This spell turns the neural pathways of the target into a superconducting network of thought. [expert only]
- [Hold Monster](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Hold%20Monster/index.md): This spell will render any living creature paralyzed. [expert only]
- [Interposing Hand](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Interposing%20Hand/index.md): Interposing Hand creates a large magic hand that appears between the caster and one opponent. [expert only]
- [Magic Jar](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Magic%20Jar/index.md): By casting Magic Jar, the caster places his soul in a gem or large crystal (known as the magic jar), leaving his body lifeless. [expert only]
- [Major Creation](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Major%20Creation/index.md): The caster creates an object of nonliving vegetable (rope, cloth, wood, etc.) or inorganic (metal, stone, plastic, etc.) matter. [expert only]
- [Passwall](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Passwall/index.md): The caster creates a passage through wooden, plaster, or stone walls, but not through metal or other harder materials. [expert only]
- [Secret Chest](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Secret%20Chest/index.md): By casting this spell, a Magic-User can hide a chest in another dimension for as long as sixty days and can retrieve it at will. [expert only]
- [Stone Shape](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Stone%20Shape/index.md): This spell can form an existing piece of stone into any shape that suits the caster’s purpose, to a total volume of 1' cubed per level. [expert only]
- [Telekinesis](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Telekinesis/index.md): By concentrating on nothing else and taking no other actions, the caster can move objects or creatures by concentrating on them. [expert only]
- [Teleport](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Teleport/index.md): This spell fixes the caster in one absolute point in space, and moves creation so that the caster appears to instantly travel an incredible distance. [expert only]
- [Transmute Rock to Mud](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Transmute%20Rock%20to%20Mud/index.md): This spell turns 3,000 square feet of rock 10' deep into mud for 3d6 days. [expert only]
- [Wall of Force](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Wall%20of%20Force/index.md): This spell creates an airtight invisible wall of force able to resist most attacks. [expert only]
- [Wall of Iron](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Wall%20of%20Iron/index.md): With this spell the caster can cause a flat, vertical iron wall to spring into being. [expert only]
- [Wall of Stone](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%205/Wall%20of%20Stone/index.md): The caster brings a stone wall into being that can be any form that the caster desires, to a maximum of 1,000 cubic feet. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 6

- [Animate Dead Monsters](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Animate%20Dead%20Monsters/index.md): This spell energizes the faint memories of life that cling to the corpses and skeletons of creatures, animating them to a mocking caricature of their living selves. [expert only]
- [Barrier](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Barrier/index.md): This spell creates a wall of whirling steel (of whatever shape the caster desires) up to 20' long per caster level, or a ring of whirling steel centred on the caster with a radius of up to 5' per two levels. [expert only]
- [Contingency](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Contingency/index.md): This spell allows the caster to cast another spell on himself, with its effect delayed until a specific situation occurs as dictated by the caster. [expert only]
- [Death Spell](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Death%20Spell/index.md): A living creature requires a certain amount of order within its body to maintain its functions. [expert only]
- [Disintegrate](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Disintegrate/index.md): This spell undoes the bonds of creation that keep a single creature or object together. [expert only]
- [Geas](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Geas/index.md): The whims of a proficient wizard are not often ignored. [expert only]
- [Glass Eye](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Glass%20Eye/index.md): The caster of this spell is able to see through walls as if a 3' square window is present. [expert only]
- [Legend Lore](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Legend%20Lore/index.md): The works and deeds of the famous and the infamous are witnessed by the universe, and all secrets are spied upon by creation, even if there is no man to record them. [expert only]
- [Lucubration](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Lucubration/index.md): This spell captures the energy of a previously cast spell and restores it to the caster. [expert only]
- [Major Globe of Invulnerability](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Major%20Globe%20of%20Invulnerability/index.md): An immobile, faintly shimmering magical 10' diameter sphere surrounds the caster and excludes all Magic-User spell effects of 4th level or lower. [expert only]
- [Mass Suggestion](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Mass%20Suggestion/index.md): As a Magic-User becomes more comfortable (never completely comfortable, just more than before) in manipulating the forces of magic, he also becomes more proficient in warping the hearts and minds of those around him. [expert only]
- [Mind Switch](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Mind%20Switch/index.md): This spell allows the caster to switch the minds of two beings. [expert only]
- [Move Earth](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Move%20Earth/index.md): A 50' cube of loose soil can be moved per Turn within the spell’s range. [expert only]
- [Phantasmal Supergoria](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Phantasmal%20Supergoria/index.md): This spell creates a creature the caster has previously seen that will obey his every mental command. [expert only]
- [Projected Image](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Projected%20Image/index.md): The caster creates a quasi-real, illusory version of himself. [expert only]
- [Shades](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Shades/index.md): The caster creates phantasmal pseudo-real monsters in an area of 20'. [expert only]
- [Speak with Monsters](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Speak%20with%20Monsters/index.md): The caster can comprehend and communicate with any creature. [expert only]
- [Stone to Flesh](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Stone%20to%20Flesh/index.md): This spell returns a petrified creature to its normal state, restoring both life and goods. [expert only]
- [Veil](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Veil/index.md): The caster instantly changes the appearance of a 20' square area, including creatures in it if desired. [expert only]
- [Weird Vortex](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%206/Weird%20Vortex/index.md): As this spell is cast, a great storm of light whips around the target and produces a random effect. [expert only]

[expert only]

- [Instant Summons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%207/Instant%20Summons/index.md): Time and space do not exist to the forces of magic, and this spell allows the Magic-User to disregard both in limited circumstances. [expert only]

- [Phase Door](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%207/Phase%20Door/index.md): This spell creates an ethereal passage through wooden, plaster, or stone walls, but not other materials, including metals. [expert only]

- [Reverse Gravity](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%207/Reverse%20Gravity/index.md): Nature is a Magic-User’s plaything, and this spell commands the earth to throw away people and objects standing upon it. [expert only]
- [Simulacrum](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%207/Simulacrum/index.md): Simulacrum creates a pseudo-duplicate of any creature. [expert only]
- [Spell Turning](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%207/Spell%20Turning/index.md): Spells and spell-like effects targeted on the caster are turned back upon the original caster. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Magic-User › List of Magic-User Spells › Level 8

- [Antipathy-Sympathy](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Antipathy-Sympathy/index.md): This spell causes an object or location to emanate magical vibrations that either attract or repel either a specific kind of intelligent creature or creatures of a particular alignment. [expert only]
- [Clone](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Clone/index.md): This spell allows the growth of a perfect physical duplicate of a person (or any living creature) and pulls the consciousness of that person from an alternate timeline, trapping it in the false body. [expert only]
- [Demand](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Demand/index.md): Personal objects, bodily refuse such as hair or nail clippings, or even freely given gifts are dangerous in the hands of a wizard. [expert only]
- [Mass Charm Person](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Mass%20Charm%20Person/index.md): The Mass Charm Person spell makes a number of subjects (subjects whose total Hit Dice is up to twice the caster’s level) utterly enamoured with the caster and desperate to please him. [expert only]
- [Maze](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Maze/index.md): The caster banishes the subject into an extra dimensional labyrinth. [expert only]
- [Mind Blank](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Mind%20Blank/index.md): The subject is protected from all devices and spells that detect, influence, or read emotions or thoughts. [expert only]
- [Permanency](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Permanency/index.md): The Permanency spell makes other spell effects permanent. [expert only]
- [Polymorph Any Object](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Polymorph%20Any%20Object/index.md): This transforms one object or creature into another. [expert only]
- [Symbol](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Symbol/index.md): This spell allows the caster to scribe a potent rune of power upon a surface. [expert only]
- [Trap the Soul](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%208/Trap%20the%20Soul/index.md): Trap the Soul forces a creature’s life force (and material body) into a gem. [expert only]

- [Imprisonment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%209/Imprisonment/index.md): When the caster casts Imprisonment and touches a creature, if it fails a saving throw versus Magic it is entombed in a state of suspended animation in a small sphere far beneath the surface of the earth. [expert only]

[expert only]
- [Shape Change](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%209/Shape%20Change/index.md): This spell enables the caster to assume the form of any single non-unique creature (of any type) except for particularly powerful creatures like demons, devils, or demi-gods. [expert only]
- [Temporal Stasis](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%209/Temporal%20Stasis/index.md): The subject is placed into a state of suspended animation. [expert only]
- [Time Stop](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Magic-User/Spells/Level%209/Time%20Stop/index.md): This spell brings all of creation (and anti-creation) to a complete halt, while allowing the caster the freedom to act in this inert universe. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › Special Rules

- [Blessings](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Special%20Rules/Blessings/index.md): The Gods might be silent but not indifferent; they allow Clerics to bless themselves and others.
- [Spell Scrolls](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Special%20Rules/Holy%20Activities/index.md): Using a scroll to invoke a miracle erases it from the scroll. [expert only]
- [Holy Water](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Special%20Rules/Holy%20Water/index.md): Most “holy water” used in religious rituals and services is merely symbolic.
- [Miracles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Special%20Rules/Miracles/index.md): Clerics are believed to be divinely inspired, and their powers are granted to Clerics through prayer.

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles

- [List of Cleric Miracles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/index.md)

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 1

- [Bless](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Bless/index.md): This spell bestows the favour of the Cleric's deity upon the subject.
- [Command](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Command/index.md): When a Cleric casts this spell, they can give the subject a single word command, which it obeys to the best of its ability.
- [Cure Light Wounds](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Cure%20Light%20Wounds/index.md): By the power of the Cleric’s faith, this spell restores 1d6 Wounds to one damaged character, plus a number of points equal to the level of the caster.
- [Detect Evil](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Detect%20Evil/index.md): “Evil,” for purposes of this spell, is an in-game colloquial term.
- [Invisibility to Undead](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Invisibility%20to%20Undead/index.md): For the duration of the spell, undead creatures cannot see, hear, or smell the subject at all, until the subject does something to intentionally gain an undead creature’s attention (including attacking).
- [Protection from Evil](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Protection%20from%20Evil/index.md): “Evil,” for purposes of this spell, is an in-game colloquial term.
- [Purify Food and Drink](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Purify%20Food%20and%20Drink/index.md): Enough food and water for up to a dozen people is made pure, removing all spoilage and poisons.
- [Remove Fear](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Remove%20Fear/index.md): This spell instills courage in the subject, and potentially removes the effect of magic-induced fear by allowing the target a saving throw versus Magic to attempt to remove the effects.
- [Sanctuary](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Sanctuary/index.md): This spell allows the subject to be attacked less often by foes.
- [Turn Undead](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%201/Turn%20Undead/index.md): One true measure of divine power is the command over life and death.

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 2

- [Augury](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Augury/index.md): This spell allows the caster to see a vision of all timelines, possibilities, and probabilities for but a moment, allowing him the chance to determine whether a particular action will bring weal or woe. [expert only]
- [Delay Poison](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Delay%20Poison/index.md): This spell counteracts the work of poison already done, weakening it, giving its victim a new chance at life. [expert only]
- [Enthrall](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Enthrall/index.md): When one’s voice is given divine authority, it will be listened to. [expert only]
- [Heat Metal](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Heat%20Metal/index.md): Those who would dare take up arms against the gods' chosen shall burn. [expert only]
- [Heroism](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Heroism/index.md): This spell grants the subject 1d4 levels’ worth of Wounds and saving throws (and, for Warriors, Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill) for the duration of the spell. [expert only]
- [Resist Cold](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Resist%20Cold/index.md): While under the effects of this spell, a character or monster is unharmed by freezing (non-magical) cold, and receives a bonus of +2 to all saving throws versus cold-based magical or breath attacks. [expert only]
- [Resist Fire](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Resist%20Fire/index.md): While under the effects of this spell, a character or monster is unharmed by intense (non-magical) heat, and he receives a bonus of +3 to all saving throws versus heat-based magical or breath attacks. [expert only]
- [Silence 15' Radius](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%202/Silence%2015%27%20Radius/index.md): Upon the casting of this spell, complete silence prevails in a diameter of 30'. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 3

- [Cure Disease](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Cure%20Disease/index.md): Through the mercy of divine powers, this spell allows a Cleric to cast out the sin and degeneracy in a person that allows evil spirits to invade his body and misalign his humours. [expert only]
- [Dispel Magic](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Dispel%20Magic/index.md): Magic is unnatural and unwanted in the intended order of things. [expert only]
- [Magic Vestment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Magic%20Vestment/index.md): This spell shields the subject by the power of faith, granting them a +1 Armour Class for every level of the caster. [expert only]
- [Remove Curse](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Remove%20Curse/index.md): Remove Curse instantaneously removes one curse on a creature if it makes a saving throw versus Magic. [expert only]
- [Sacrifice](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Sacrifice/index.md): This spell allows the Cleric to transfer any desired number of Wounds from himself to the target. [expert only]
- [Water Walk](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%203/Water%20Walk/index.md): The subject of this spell is granted divine favour, allowing him to walk on water, or any kind of liquid, as if it were dry land. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 4

- [Cure Serious Wounds](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Cure%20Serious%20Wounds/index.md): By the power of the Cleric’s faith and the strength of the life force of the wounded character, this spell restores 1d6 Wounds to one damaged character, plus a number of points equal to the level of the caster, plus a… [expert only]
- [Detect Lie](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Detect%20Lie/index.md): This spell allows the caster to determine if any one statement made to him in the past hour was the truth or a lie. [expert only]
- [Divination](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Divination/index.md): The Divine powers know everything that was, everything that is, and everything that will be. [expert only]
- [Neutralize Poison](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Neutralize%20Poison/index.md): The caster removes all trace of venom and poison in the creature or object touched. [expert only]
- [Protection from Evil 10' Radius](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Protection%20from%20Evil%2010%27%20Radius/index.md): “Evil,” for purposes of this spell, is an in-game colloquial term. [expert only]
- [Spell Immunity](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%204/Spell%20Immunity/index.md): The caster can use this spell to grant resistance to all spells and spell-like abilities, improving his chance to make saves versus Magic. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 5

- [Commune](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/Commune/index.md): By entering into deep meditation, the Cleric’s spirit momentarily ascends to its final reward for a glimpse of the afterlife for the devout believer. [expert only]
- [Cure Critical Wounds](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/Cure%20Critical%20Wounds/index.md): By the power of the Cleric’s faith, this spell restores 4d6 Wounds to one damaged character, plus a number of points equal to the level of the caster. [expert only]
- [Dispel Evil](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/Dispel%20Evil/index.md): Through the magnificence of the most holy powers of the universe, all summoned or other enchanted creatures within 30' of the caster must succeed in a saving throw versus Magic or be destroyed. [expert only]
- [Insect Plague](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/Insect%20Plague/index.md): The caster summons a swarm of locusts in a 60' diameter. [expert only]
- [Quest](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/Quest/index.md): When this spell is cast on a character, a saving throw versus Magic is allowed. [expert only]
- [True Seeing](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%205/True%20Seeing/index.md): The caster confers on a subject the ability to ignore all of the lies told to us by our natural eyes and to see all things as they actually are. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 6

- [Anti-Magic Shell](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Anti-Magic%20Shell/index.md): Casting this spell restores the supremacy of natural order in a small area for a short amount of time. [expert only]
- [Find the Path](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Find%20the%20Path/index.md): The recipient of this spell can find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specified destination, whether into or out of a locale. [expert only]
- [Forbiddance](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Forbiddance/index.md): Forbiddance seals a 60' square area against all planar travel, either into or out of it, or within it. [expert only]
- [Heal](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Heal/index.md): Heal enables the caster to channel divine energy into a creature to wipe away injury and afflictions. [expert only]
- [Tongues](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Tongues/index.md): This spell allows the Cleric to communicate with one specific being. [expert only]
- [Word of Recall](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%206/Word%20of%20Recall/index.md): The casting of this spell summons the very essence of his deity to protect him, and this divine force removes the caster from his current location and delivers him instantly to his sanctuary. [expert only]

## Character Creation › Classes › Cleric › List of Cleric Miracles › Level 7

- [Control Weather](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%207/Control%20Weather/index.md): To be in control of divine power is to control the natural order, and this spell is the ultimate manifestation of that control as the caster can change the weather in the local area. [expert only]
- [Earthquake](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%207/Earthquake/index.md): The wrath of divine power is a terrible thing to behold, and this spell allows the Cleric to command this wrath and unleash it against his enemies! [expert only]
- [Holy Word](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%207/Holy%20Word/index.md): The language of gods is not one for mortal ears. [expert only]
- [Part Water](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Classes/Cleric/Miracles/Level%207/Part%20Water/index.md): The caster creates a path 10' wide and a maximum of 120' long through water, such as a pond, lake, river, or other body of water. [expert only]

## Character Creation

- [Alignment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Alignment/index.md): Alignment defines a character’s side in the eternal war between the forces of Order and the Chaos Gods.
- [Starting Possessions](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Starting%20Possessions/index.md): All Characters begin play with money and equipment.
- [Name](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Name/index.md): The Referee should inform Players as to the general theme of the campaign, and it is important to choose a name that will complement that theme.
- [Advancement](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Character/Advancement/index.md): Experience Points (XP) are a measure of improvement and progress for Player Characters.

## Equipment

- [Equipment](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/index.md): All equipment a character may purchase or acquire during play.
- [Armour](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Armor/index.md): Armour Rating is added to Armour Class.

## Equipment › Weapons

- [Weapons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/index.md): These are the weapons of the age, which runs from Pavia to the peace that ended the Thirty Years' War.
- [Melee Weapons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/Melee%20Weapons/index.md): The century did not offer an endless armoury.
- [Ranged Weapons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/Ranged%20Weapons/index.md): A crossbow is not a firearm: its bolt meets the ordinary Armour Rating, and its armour modifier is what makes it worth the spanning.
- [Firearms](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/Firearms/index.md): The table lists complete, ordinary examples with the lock most often supplied for that weapon.
- [Curious Firearms](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/Curious%20Firearms/index.md): This page keeps rare experiments and displaced equipment available to Expert campaigns without presenting them as ordinary purchases of the age. [expert only]
- [Curious Weapons](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Weapons/Curious%20Weapons/index.md): This page keeps fighting systems and weapons that do not belong among the ordinary purchases of the age, for Expert campaigns that want them. [expert only]

## Equipment

- [Animals](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Animals/index.md)
- [Containers](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Containers/index.md): A quiver plus the arrows or bolts it carries (20 maximum) counts as one item for encumbrance.
- [Food](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Food/index.md)
- [Lodging](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Lodging/index.md): Costs are per day, unless noted.
- [Vehicles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Vehicles/index.md): Prices buy a sound, workaday vehicle with ordinary fittings.
- [Antiquated Vehicles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Antiquated%20Vehicles/index.md): These entries are retained for ruins, legendary voyages, archaic regions, and campaigns that deliberately reach outside the age. [expert only]
- [Services](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Services/index.md)
- [Miscellaneous](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Equipment/Miscellaneous/index.md): Holy water, if in a glass container or flask, can be thrown with the same range modifiers as a rock.

## Retainers

- [Retainers](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Retainers/index.md): An adventuring party is often more than just the sum of the player characters.
- [Hiring Retainers](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Retainers/Hiring%20Retainers/index.md): In most civilized areas, it is not difficult to find people who are out of work.
- [Morale Checks](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Retainers/Morale%20Checks/index.md): For domestic retainers, Morale should be checked in any of the following cases:
- [Expanded Retainer List](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Retainers/Expanded%20Retainer%20List/index.md): A slave costs 50 sp, or 20 sp if purchased as a child.

## Adventuring

- [Adventuring](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/index.md): Rules governing what happens outside of direct combat — travel, exploration, survival, and recovery.
- [Party Organization](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Party%20Organization/index.md): An expedition that sorts itself out before the torches are lit moves twice as fast at the table and dies half as often in play.
- [Skills](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Skills/index.md): Characters may possess various skills such as but not limited to: Architecture, Tinkering, Search.
- [Time and Movement](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Time%20and%20Movement/index.md): Within the game, time passes as is convenient for play.
- [Dungeon Exploration](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Dungeon%20Exploration/index.md): Underground and indoor exploration — ruins, crypts, mines, cellars, and every other place the sun does not reach — is played out in Turns of ten minutes.
- [Wilderness Travel](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Wilderness%20Travel/index.md): Beyond the walls, time is counted in watches.

## Adventuring › Hazards

- [Hazards](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Hazards/index.md): Hazards are the non-combat dangers characters face in the world.
- [Damage](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Hazards/Damage/index.md): Stamina represents the ability of a trained character to control a dangerous situation: to duck at the last moment, roll with a blow, twist away from a blade, and keep fighting despite exhaustion.
- [Physical Deterioration](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Hazards/Physical%20Deterioration/index.md): A character who falls to zero in any ability score dies. [expert only]
- [Substance and Toxins](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Hazards/Substance%20and%20Toxins/index.md): Alcohol is far more pernicious, as it is quite common for most everyone to use it to excess, as beer and wine are often safer to drink than plain water. [expert only]
- [Environmental](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Hazards/Environmental/index.md): Exception: Characters trained in acrobatics — at the Referee's discretion, typically Rogues and similar — may make a check when falling.

## Adventuring

- [Healing](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Adventuring/Healing/index.md): Damaged characters who have at least half of their Wounds remaining recover 1 Wound after a peaceful night’s rest.

## Encounters

- [Encounters](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/index.md): Encounters are any situation where the player characters meet other characters or creatures in uncertain circumstances.
- [Surprise](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Surprise/index.md): When surprise is possible, roll 1d6 for each side which might be surprised; most normal characters are surprised on a roll of 1–2.
- [Encounter Distance](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Encounter%20Distance/index.md): Encounters begin with the closest opposing characters 3d6×10' apart, unless there are specific details which would define the encounter distance, such as being in fog or a forest.
- [Reaction Roll](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Reaction%20Roll/index.md): In most instances, NPCs’ reactions will be obvious based on the circumstance of the encounter.
- [Initiative](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Initiative/index.md): At the start of each round, one player rolls 1d6 for the player characters’ side, and the Referee rolls 1d6 for each opposing party.
- [Combat Actions](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Combat%20Actions/index.md): Each character can perform a single action on their turn.
- [Measure and Reach](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Measure%20and%20Reach/index.md): A fight is not fought at one distance. [expert only]
- [Monsters and NPCs](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Monsters%20and%20NPCs/index.md): Player Characters attack with Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill and save by their class tables.
- [Morale](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/Encounters/Morale/index.md): NPCs and monsters do not always fight to the death; in fact, most will try to avoid death whenever possible.

## Machine-readable

- [Spells](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/data/spells.json): Magic-User spells with class, level, duration, range and rules text.
- [Miracles](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/data/miracles.json): Cleric miracles, same shape as the spells.
- [Careers](https://angrysigma.github.io/vogelfrei/data/careers.json): careers by class, with status, traits and level progression.
